outcome: cord blood drug levels at delivery
cohort: 31 pregnant women with inflammatory bowel disease who were exposed to either ustekinumab or vedolizumab within 2 months prior to conception or during pregnancy
finding: Vedolizumab demonstrated lower drug levels in cord blood compared to maternal blood at delivery, while the placental transfer of ustekinumab seems to have a pattern similar to anti-tumour necrosis factor (TNF) agents.
